blocks.text: Population survivorship kisi group ke un afraad ki percentage hai jo kisi khaas umr tak zinda hain. Ise aksar survivorship graphs mein survivorship curves ki shakal mein dikhaya jata hai. In graphs mein Y-axis par zinda bache hue afraad ki tadaad aur X-axis par umr hoti hai. Aise graphs mein teen qisam ke survivorship curves bante hain.

blocks.alt: Bache hue afraad ki tadaad (log scale 0.1, 1, 10, 100) aur umr (1, 3, 5) ka graph. Type I (convex), surkh, ooncha rehta aur aakhir mein tezi se girta. Type II (diagonal), neela, upar baen se neeche daen seedhi lakeer. Type III (concave), narangi, foran tezi se gir kar neeche seedha ho jata.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.7: Survivorship curves (kitab ki Figure 25.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Y-axis log scale hai: har nishaan pichhle se das guna (0.1, 1, 10, 100). Isi liye Type II ki seedhi lakeer ka matlab hai ke har umr mein marne ka imkaan aik jaisa hai. Kitab ke graph mein sab se neeche wala nishaan '0' likha hai, lekin log scale par 0 nahi aa sakta; das guna ki tarteeb se woh 0.1 banta hai, is liye yahan 0.1 likha gaya hai.

items: Type I (convex, bahar ko ubhra hua) populations: In mein afraad budhape tak zinda rehte hain aur phir tezi se marte hain. Maut par mahol ka asar bohat kam hota hai; zyada tar afraad apni poori mumkina umr jeete hain. Insanon aur mammals ki populations Type I survivorship dikhati hain.

Type II (diagonal, tirchhi seedhi lakeer) populations: In mein afraad ke marne ka imkaan saari zindagi ek jaisa rehta hai. Maut par mahol ka ahem asar hota hai, aur mahol bachchon par boorhon se zyada sakht nahin hota. Parindon, chhipkaliyon aur rodents (kutarne wale janwar, jaise choohe) ki populations Type II curves dikhati hain.

Type III (concave, andar ko dhansa hua) populations: In mein bachchon ki sharah-e-amwaat (juvenile mortality) bohat zyada hoti hai. Lekin jo jawani tak pohanch jayen un ke marne ki sharah bohat kam hoti hai. Machhliyan aur bohat se invertebrates (baghair reerh ki haddi wale janwar) Type III curves dikhate hain.

blocks.text: Ek khaas muddat mein afraad ki tadaad mein izafe ko population growth kehte hain. Yeh populations ki ek ahem khasiyat hai. Population growth ke do models hain.

Exponential growth model: Is model ke mutabiq population baghair kisi had ke apni zyada se zyada raftaar se barhti hai. Har nasl mein ek muqarrar tadaad ke afraad jurne ke bajaye population har unit waqt mein ek hi nisbat (ratio) se barhti hai, yaani jitni bari population, utna bara izafa (J shakal ka curve). Har population exponential growth nahin dikhati.

Logistic growth model: Is model mein barhti hui population aakhir kaar wasail (resources) jaise jagah, roshni, paani ya nutrients ki kami ki wajah se ek had tak pohanch jati hai. Aisi population ek khaas size par ruk kar mustaqil ho jati hai jise us jagah ki carrying capacity kehte hain. Aisi soorat mein growth curve sigmoid, yaani chapti S, shakal ka hota hai.

blocks.alt: Aabadi ke size (0 se 1250) aur naslon ki tadaad (0 se 15) ka aik graph. Do curves taqreeban 4thi nasl par saath shuru hote hain. Exponential growth (gulabi, J shakal) tez se tez barh kar taqreeban 8.5 nasl tak 1000 se upar. Logistic growth (neela, S shakal) dheema ho kar carrying capacity, taqreeban 750, par ruk jata.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 25.8 ke y-axis par 'Population sze' chhapa hai; sahi 'Population size' (aabadi ka size) hai, jo khaake mein likha hai.

Population density fi unit raqba (area) ya hajm (volume) afraad ki tadaad hai. Maslan Muzaffarabad mein fi murabba kilometer shehtoot (mulberry) ke darakhton ki tadaad, ya test tube mein fi milliliter E. coli bacteria ki tadaad. Zyada density wali populations mein, jab population apni carrying capacity ke qareeb pohanchti hai, to wasail ke liye muqabla (competition) bohat sakht ho sakta hai; is se paidaish ki sharah kam aur maut ka khatra zyada ho jata hai. Zyada population density se aaloodgi (pollution) bhi barh sakti hai.
4- Population Dispersion ya Distribution (afraad ka phailao)
Population ki banawat ki ek aur ahem khasiyat yeh hai ke population ke afraad apne ilaqe mein kis tarah phaile ya bikhre hue hain.

items: Random spacing (be-tarteeb phailao): Is mein population ke afraad ek doosre se zyada ta'alluq nahin rakhte. Yeh qudrat mein aam nahin. Maslan yeh kuch aise paudon mein hota hai jin ke beej hawa se bikharte hain aur jahan bhi munasib mahol mein girein, ug jate hain.

Uniform spacing (barabar faasle par phailao): Kuch populations mein afraad barabar faasle par phaile hote hain. Maslan kuch paudon ki species apne qareeb doosre paudon ko ugne nahin deteen, is liye har paude ke darmiyan barabar faasla rehta hai. Isi tarah apna ilaqa (territory) muqarrar rakhne wale janwar, jaise ande sene wale penguins, bhi uniform phailao dikhate hain.

Clumped spacing (guchhon mein phailao): Kuch populations mein afraad wasail ki ghair barabar taqseem ki wajah se groups ya guchhon (clusters) mein jama ho jate hain. Clumped spacing qudrat mein aam hai, kyun ke janwar, paude aur microorganisms wasail se bhari jaghon ko pasand karte hain. Yeh un paudon mein dekha jata hai jo apne beej seedha zameen par girate hain, ya un janwaron mein jo groups mein rehte hain.

blocks.alt: Nuqton ke teen murabba hisse. Random: be-tarteeb bikhre nuqte. Uniform: qataron mein barabar faasle par nuqte. Clumped: teen ghane guchhon mein nuqte.
blocks.caption: Random, uniform aur clumped phailao (kitab ki figure nahi; is topic ke liye hamara khaaka).

blocks.text: Carrying capacity kisi species ke afraad ki woh zyada se zyada tadaad hai jise koi khaas mahol lambe arse tak mustaqil taur par sambhal (support kar) sake. Carrying capacity "limiting factors" (had muqarrar karne wale awamil) se tay hoti hai, jaise khuraak, paani, panah-gah aur ghonsle banane ki jaghon ki dastiyabi, aur shikari janwaron (predators) aur bimariyon ki maujoodgi.
6- Minimal Viable Population Size (kam se kam qabil-e-baqa aabadi)

Minimal viable population size afraad ki woh sab se kam tadaad hai jo kisi population ke ecosystem mein zinda rehne aur qaim rehne ke liye zaroori hai. Agar population is had se neeche gir jaye to us ke khatam (extinct) hone ka khatra bohat barh jata hai. Bohat chhoti population mein (jaise Pakistan mein bache hue chand Himalayan Brown Bears) inbreeding (qareebi rishtedaron mein nasl kashi) hoti hai. Is se genetic kamzoriyan paida hoti hain aur bimariyon ke khilaf immunity (qudrati difa) kam ho jati hai. Mazeed yeh ke koi ek qudrati aafat (maslan sailab ya jangal ki aag) aisi population ko mita sakti hai jo apne minimal viable size se kam ho.

blocks.title: Day of Eight Billion
blocks.text: Duniya ki aabadi ko 7 se 8 billion hone mein 12 saal lage. 2022 mein yeh 8 billion ho gayi. Ab 9 billion tak pohanchne mein taqreeban 15 saal (2037 tak) lagenge. 2050 tak duniya ki aabadi taqreeban 10 billion ho jayegi, aur is ki bari aksariyat ab bhi taraqqi pazeer (developing) ilaqon mein rahegi.

blocks.prompt: Hazaron ande dene wali machhli ke liye kaun si survivorship qisam mutawaqqa hai?
blocks.explanation: Type III: zyada tar bachche jaldi marte, lekin jawani tak pohanchne wale chand kaheen behtar bachte hain.

items: Survivorship curves: Type I (convex; insan, mammals), Type II (diagonal; parinde, chhipkaliyan, rodents), Type III (concave; machhliyan, invertebrates).
Growth: exponential (J, baghair had) aur logistic (S, carrying capacity par ruk jati hai).
Density: fi unit area/volume afraad; dispersion: random, uniform, clumped (sab se aam).
Carrying capacity limiting factors se tay hoti hai; minimal viable size se kam population ko extinction ka bara khatra hai.
